topics.title: US moves toward deep-sea mining permits
topics.summary: The Trump administration signaled it is moving toward approving deep-sea mining permits within months, according to reports on October 18. The effort is part of a broader push to expand access to critical minerals for electronics and defense industries.
topics.detail: The reporting says Interior Secretary Doug Burgum announced the plan on Monday. It also says the administration is seeking both domestic and international mining permits. Earthjustice and conservation groups are challenging the permits in court, while opponents warn about possible harm to marine animals and biodiversity.

topics.title: Quantum computing funding and hardware accelerate
topics.summary: Several quantum computing developments landed in the window, including a large funding round, government benchmarking progress, and a hardware interconnect demonstration. The strongest single source in the set was a weekly round-up dated October 11.
topics.detail: The round-up said Oratomic closed a $475 million Series B valuing the company at $5.4 billion. It also said DARPA advanced four more companies in the Quantum Benchmarking Initiative and that IonQ reported a memory-enhanced photonic interconnect with more than 1,000 events per second and 87.9 percent fidelity. A separate source on October 11 reported Hamad Bin Khalifa University and Quantum Computing Inc. partnering on quantum skills.
